title: From Bitvectors to Behavior
subtitle: The Mathematics of a Binary Lift
description: Deriving machine arithmetic, condition flags, path semantics, and the proof obligations behind HydIR's bounded x86-64 lift.
lead: A register holds bits. A branch gives those bits an interpretation. Preserving that distinction is the first obligation of a binary lifter.

title: From Graphs to Code
subtitle: The Compiler Theory Inside HydIR
description: A detailed walk through bounded CFG recovery, fixed-point dataflow analysis, explicit SSA, parallel phi copies, and conservative effect summaries.
lead: The hard part of lifting is deciding what every value means on every incoming edge. Control-flow graphs and fixed points make that question precise.

title: Ghidra P-code, Explained
subtitle: Varnodes, State, and the Decompiler
description: A deep guide to Ghidra P-code: address spaces, varnodes, widths, memory, branches, raw versus high P-code, and a real x86-64 example.
lead: One x86 instruction can create many smaller effects. Learn to read the varnodes and operations between machine code and Ghidra's C view.
